sentences.text: There was a strange sensation in my mouth.
I do not want to complicate the rules of our game.
It can frustrate me when answers are not direct.

We moved to a new house this month. There was so much to do that it could overwhelm us, but Dad made a deliberate plan. We packed our furniture and put a name on every box. The boxes were conveniently placed near each room. Contrary to what I feared, moving day was fun! The transition to our new home was easier because everyone helped. I cannot wait to set up my new room.

A famous architect came to speak at our school. She showed us a sophisticated plan for a new building, but explained it in a simple way. She even showed how a ramp can remove a barrier for someone in a wheelchair. Her expertise and courage inspired me. My ambition grew as I listened to her. One day, I hope to design a building that helps people too.
The teacher will dictate the sentences for the pupils to write.
One large apple is equivalent to two small ones in my bowl.
The park rules prohibit dogs from swimming in the duck pond.

The family next door had an emergency last week. Their little cat was in distress after getting stuck in a small hole. Dad reached down alongside the wall and helped it out. We were so happy when it was safe. Later, the family built a small enclosure in the garden so the cat would not get stuck again. The little cat is now friends with our cat, and neither of them is aggressive. It felt good to help.

We spent a wonderful day at the town fair. Mum found a real bargain at a toy shop, where a friendly merchant sold us a toy train. Next, we paid for admission to a steam train ride and climbed into an old red carriage. As a passenger, I watched the train move along the track. It slowed at a junction before turning left. Later, we showed our receipt and got a free snack. We walked more than one kilometre around the fair and went home with a great feeling of satisfaction.
I look through the toy catalogue to choose my birthday gift this year.
I put the letter for my grandma inside a big white envelope.
The police had a suspicion that someone had entered the house.

A doctor came to our school and gave us a comprehensive talk about staying healthy. She explained why a cigarette is harmful to our body. She also told us that sweets should not substitute for a proper meal. At the end, we made a resolution to eat well, sleep well and stay active. I want to embrace her advice and make healthy choices each day.

Dad and I sometimes watch the news during the interval between our favourite shows. One day, Dad explained that a recession can make life harder for families and businesses. He also told me how a capitalist economy allows people to own businesses. We heard about a controversy between two countries, where a diplomat was trying to help. Dad tells me not to speculate until I know the facts. I sometimes contradict him, but he explains his reasons. We also learned how some countries fought for independence. These talks help me understand the world better.
Humans have biological needs such as food, water, and sleep.
The king decided to summon his advisers for a meeting.
I try not to interfere when my friends solve a problem together.

Watering the garden with Grandpa is our morning ritual. I am always reluctant to leave because there is so much to see. Grandpa knows the flavour of every herb and can name each insect we find. Bees circulate around the flowers, while young plants grow in a small nursery. Grandpa says gardening can stimulate the mind. Each day, I accumulate a little more knowledge from him.

Our class visited a court to learn about the law. A magistrate showed us around, and a constable explained how the law helps protect every civilian. We walked along a long corridor and learned about the hierarchy of the court. I asked who can prosecute a case, and the magistrate explained it clearly. He told us that everyone should have a fair and legitimate hearing. The visit helped reinforce why rules and fairness are important.
Parents often sacrifice their time to care for their children.
My uncle works as an accountant for a large company in the city.
A tiny baby bird is vulnerable so its mother keeps it safe.

Our school held a science fair, and I decided to join. My hypothesis was that plants grow best in warm light. After a few weeks, I got a satisfactory result. The judge asked me to differentiate between the two groups of plants. My answer seemed to astonish him! I received a certificate and a small prize as an incentive to keep learning. It was an extraordinary day that made me proud of my hard work and intelligence.

This month, I am working on my favourite history project. I enjoy mathematics and geography too, but history lets me learn about people from the past. My project is about an emperor and a brave pioneer. With my teacher’s permission, Dad helped me reproduce an old map. We measured each dimension in centimetres. I learned about the significance of their journeys and tried to see life from their perspective. It was hard work, but I was proud of what I made.
She learned how to pronounce the difficult word correctly.
The two friends reached a compromise after discussing the problem.
The office staff manage all the administrative work for the whole school.

Last week, I had a wonderful opportunity to help my community. My friends and I volunteered at the park and picked up rubbish together. A kind lady told us we were very responsible. I felt grateful to help on such a magnificent morning. It showed me that even a small act can make a significant difference. I will volunteer again with great enthusiasm

My team played in a football tournament this year. We practised every afternoon and put in tremendous effort. Our teacher taught us to stay confident and work as a team. Every participant tried their best in the final game. In the last minute, I passed the ball and my friend scored! It was a brilliant moment, and we were proud of what we achieved together.
The temperature drops in winter, so I wear my warm coat everyday.
It is impolite to interrupt someone while they are speaking.
Studies show that regular exercise may correlate with better health.

This year, I am a journalist for our school paper. My teacher will supervise our work before we broadcast the news to the class. This week, the highlight is the weather forecast! I use a simple framework to plan each story and check every line to eliminate mistakes. We publish once a week, and that frequency works well. Meanwhile, my perception of news has changed, and our paper is gaining a good reputation. It is a privilege to share our work with the school.

We watched an episode about how birds migrate. Thousands of birds can move in a formation at the same time, almost in one simultaneous wave. A satellite can track their approximate path from space. A scholar on the show explained this amazing phenomenon. Each new fact was a stimulus to learn more. The birds coordinate their movements as they fly, and sometimes a dominant bird leads the group. Through evolution, some birds can even swallow small insects while flying. Nature never fails to fascinate me!
My whole family gathers for a big special dinner at Thanksgiving every year.
The doctor will discharge me from the hospital tomorrow morning after breakfast.
We should never discriminate against others because of their differences.

My family flew on an airline to visit a foreign country. I was so enthusiastic about our first international adventure! The terminal was busy, and our departure was early in the morning. From my window seat, the landscape below looked beautiful. The countryside was full of green fields, and I even saw an old cathedral. Dad helped me translate some local words. Travel is a wonderful way to learn about the world!

My grandma and grandpa celebrate their anniversary every year. This year, our family planned a spectacular dinner for them. We made their favourite vegetable dish and a delicious cake. Everyone arrived with gifts and warm smiles. Grandpa told funny stories about their trips, and the room was soon filled with laughter. It was a lovely evening for our whole family to be together.
